scope: Isolated emitted native/full Ambient fields, desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2 at CPU1/4. Eight-second interrupted stories retain complete original simulation and measure actual RAF intervals, long tasks, first paint, readiness and CDP traces. Fonts are prepared before mounting; no per-frame model inspection or pixel readback. Physical input is verified separately. Measurements exclude public route transfer and leave final timing gates open.

checkoutLineEndings.policy: Measured source hashes bind actual checkout bytes. Only these unchanged UTF-8 files differ from their Git blobs by CRLF to LF normalization. Every new or changed payload must match the Git index exactly before publication.
